# Source-indexed generation audit: repeated preparation is not generated by a one-use kernel

## Frozen claim and required datum

The first unproved universal clause in `research/nima/carrier-generated-sector-interface-falsifier.md` is canonical generation of the complete sector interface from a frozen source record using a fixed shared operation inventory. The common typed lifting calculus itself is already stated in `research/nima/cross-sector-constructor-instrument-theorem.md`.

A concrete required interface datum is available without inventing a cross-sector bridge: the repeated-preparation joint law needed to transport Flavor WP968's feature-covariance certificate. `research/flavor/flavor-preparation-grammar-source-closure.md` (WP970) explicitly audits that requirement. It distinguishes a one-use FDM-2 sign kernel from labelled repeated preparations with an apparatus reset/return law.

We use that bounded source version, not the much older WP60 inventory as a statement of all current flavor sources. No new physical apparatus or owner adoption is asserted.

## Provenance audit

| Datum | Existing source | Operation/status |
|---|---|---|
| Uniform one-use sign law | FDM-2 kernel as frozen by WP970 | Declared per-use mathematical law; physical unbiased source remains open |
| Faithful flavor reading type | physical16, as identified by WP970 | Does not itself prepare independent copies |
| Required repeated feature packet | WP968 requirement recorded in WP970 | Its covariance depends on the joint preparation law |
| Repeated-use joint law | Not fixed by the one-use kernel | Fresh versus shared couplings remain distinct |
| Physical reset/return mechanism | Required by WP970; absent from its fully admitted candidate packages | Must derive, not assume, the inter-use coupling |
| Pointwise covariance result | Prior conditional readout theorem | Does not automatically transport to arbitrary repeated contexts |

The first failed inference is therefore `one-use kernel -> physically authorized repeated joint preparation`, before a repeated covariance certificate can be assigned.

## Exact nonuniqueness witness

For uniform signs X1,X2, the independent law assigns probability1/4 to each of the four pairs. The shared law assigns probability1/2 to (-1,-1) and (1,1). Both have the same one-slot marginals. Nevertheless

    Var((X1+X2)/2) = 1/2  (independent),
    Var((X1+X2)/2) = 1    (shared).

More generally, with the same uniform marginals and rho=E[X1 X2],

    P(++ )=P(-- )=(1+rho)/4,
    P(+- )=P(-+ )=(1-rho)/4,
    Var((X1+X2)/2)=(1+rho)/2.

Thus the missing datum is an actual correlation coordinate, not a normalization convention. For N centered unit-variance outputs,

    Var(mean)=1/N + (2/N^2) sum_(i<j) Cov(Xi,Xj).

Independent preparations yield1/N; a shared sign yields1 at every N. This gives an exact bridge from missing source composition data to failure of an assumed repeated-readout error bound. It is not repaired by one-use faithfulness or an idempotence equation.

## What this does and does not falsify

It falsifies the inference that the declared one-use law alone canonically determines the required repeated-use covariance interface. This is a recovered prior source obstruction, not a new discovery of the fresh/shared example.

It does NOT, by itself, refute the full source-indexed generation conjecture. The latter may require a richer source record containing independently admitted preparation/reset and correlation data. Neither hypothetical coupling has thereby become a physically realized flavor apparatus. If repeated preparation is outside the frozen interface's scope, this witness does not refute that narrower interface either.

An ambient tensor/product construction can define independent copies mathematically. It cannot establish that repeated operation of the same physical apparatus implements those copies. Treating that identification as a structural map silently adds the missing premise.

## Structural consequence

Any generation-completeness claim that includes repeatable instruments must expose source authority for contextual composition: slot identities, apparatus state, return/reset law and the induced joint law. A source record of coefficient/support/boundary/pairing data is not automatically sufficient unless those fields actually encode these operations and laws. Adding the desired covariance itself as input would merely make the output tautological.

The next admissible evidence is an independently derived apparatus/composition law predicting the joint feature statistics before those statistics are used. More one-use calculations or another common-calculus taxonomy cannot fill this gap. WP970 already supplies this stopping boundary; no duplicate flavor task is opened here.

## Verification boundary

`check_source_generation_repeated_preparation.py` reads the fresh/shared laws directly from WP970's checker without executing its owner-output writes, verifies exact marginals and variances, and checks the correlation parametrization on rational controls. The general identities above follow by expanding the variance. The owner census remains prior source evidence; this finite probability audit does not independently establish the absence of every physical flavor apparatus.
